user.title: Set up Onboard Manager
user.description: Configure roles for your onboard roster.

error.no_roles: You must specify at least one role.

init.title: Edit Roles
init.description: Modify the available roles. Removing a role will reassign users to the first role.

error.no_roles: You must specify at least one role.

set_user.name: Set user settings
set_user.description: Update onboard status, notification preference, or role for a user.

user_id.name: User ID
user_id.description: The Home Assistant internal user ID.

username.name: Username
username.description: The Home Assistant username (alternative to User ID).

onboard.name: Onboard
onboard.description: Set whether the user is currently onboard.

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Set whether the user receives notifications.

role.name: Role
role.description: Assign a role to the user (slug or label, e.g. 'crew').

set_user_notifiers.name: Set user notifiers
set_user_notifiers.description: Add, remove, or replace the list of notification services for a user. Use the 'List notifiers' action to discover available services.

user_id.name: User ID
user_id.description: The Home Assistant internal user ID.

username.name: Username
username.description: The Home Assistant username (alternative to User ID).

notifiers.name: Notifiers
notifiers.description: Notification services to assign. A list or comma-separated string (e.g. 'notify.mobile_app_anna, notify.telegram_anna').

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: How to update the list: 'replace' overwrites, 'add' appends new entries, 'remove' deletes entries.

reload_users.name: Reload users
reload_users.description: Force a re-sync of all Home Assistant users into the onboard roster.

export_state.name: Export state
export_state.description: Return the current roles, users, and active notifiers as response data (for debugging).

list_notifiers.name: List notifiers
list_notifiers.description: List all available notification services registered in Home Assistant. Useful for discovering which services can be assigned to users.

domain_filter.name: Domain filter
domain_filter.description: Optional filter to narrow results (e.g. 'mobile_app' to show only mobile app notifiers).
